# Publications

## Peer-Reviewed Publications

::: {#refs}
:::

::: {=html}
<script>
// Bold Chelsey's own name wherever it appears in the bibliography -- as
// lead author CSL renders it "Beese, Chelsey M.", as a co-author further
// down the list it renders "Chelsey M. Beese". (A Lua filter can't do this:
// citeproc fills in #refs after Quarto's user filters run, so a filter
// walking the AST for "Beese" never sees the rendered names.)
document.querySelectorAll('#refs .csl-entry').forEach(function (entry) {
  entry.innerHTML = entry.innerHTML.replace(
    /(Beese, Chelsey M\.|Chelsey M\. Beese)/g,
    '<strong>$1</strong>'
  );
});
</script>
:::
